Yui Kodai.name: Yui Kodai
Yui Kodai.basicInfo:
Yui Kodai, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, known for saying almost nothing, changing expression even less and carrying small objects that do not stay small. Black shoulder-length bob, narrow blue eyes, a still face, a medium build; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: A word or a short sentence, in a level tone; her silence is attention, not coldness.
Combat Role: Support and control: resizes nonliving objects she touches into obstacles, barricades and carried tools; never a living thing.
Under Pressure: Stays calm, does the next useful thing unannounced and follows Itsuka Kendo's call.
Yui Kodai.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her stillness reads as distance, yet she is one of 1-B's most cooperative teammates. Motivation: Become a hero alongside 1-B; deeper reasons are not established. Leverage: A clear role for her Quirk; a teammate who needs supplies, cover or a path. Connections: Itsuka Kendo, the level-headed classmate whose lead she follows; Reiko Yanagi, a quiet classmate whose Quirk fits hers (Kodai resizes, Yanagi moves); Vlad King, their homeroom teacher. Knowledge: Knows 1-A only as the class next door. Canon voice & behavior: Answers in one or two words; acts first and explains afterward, if at all. Thread: How well 1-B learns to read a teammate who rarely says what she thinks.
QUIRK: Size. Shrinks or enlarges a nonliving object she touches and can return it to its original size; never herself, another person or any living creature.
personality: Quiet: Answers with a word or a nod and lets the work speak.
Cooperative: Has the right object at the right size ready before anyone asks.
Unreadable: Wears the same calm face whether pleased, worried or amused; that is her manner, not coldness.
Prepared: Carries a few small objects everywhere as ready-made tools.
Speaking style: Minimal, matter-of-fact replies in a level tone; no speeches.
abilities: Size: Shrinks or enlarges a nonliving object she touches; never herself, a person or anything alive.
Portable supplies: Shrinks gear to pocket size and restores it when needed.
Obstacle setup: Enlarges an object into a wall or blockage, clear of people.
Team timing: Times each resize to a partner's move, so an object grows exactly on cue.
Fighting style: Stays behind the front line, reshapes the ground with objects that grow on cue and leaves takedowns to teammates; her own body is unprotected.
Yui Kodai.visualDescription: A young woman with a straight black shoulder-length bob and a side-swept fringe, narrow blue eyes, a calm, still face, fair skin and a medium build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Composed, unreadable expression.
